name: openengineer-classic
description: The colygon/openengineer roster: 12 roles, one per AI lab. Default template for full 24-slot competitive runs (P1).

seats.duty: Main orchestrator. Decompose the prompt into tasks.md with one task per teammate and clear acceptance criteria; push it first, then arbitrate scope questions and keep the team unblocked.
Autonomous deep worker. Own the core implementation; keep the repo runnable with every push.
Deep reasoning. Take the hardest sub-problem the architect hands off and deliver a working solution with your reasoning documented.
OSS code & docs search. Find the right libraries and reference implementations; record choices and links in CITATIONS.md.
Broad knowledge synthesis. Turn the prompt into concrete requirements and acceptance criteria in REQUIREMENTS.md before implementation hardens.
Fast codebase exploration. Continuously review teammates' pushes; file concise issues in ISSUES.md and flag integration breaks early.
Visual/UI. Own layout, styling, and interaction polish; push early so integration sees real markup.
Strategic planning. Watch the clock; cut scope in tasks.md when the deadline demands it and make sure something shippable exists at all times.
Architecture advisor. Advise the architect in ADVICE.md; you do not commit application code.
Plan reviewer and tester. Test against acceptance criteria; record findings in QA.md and fix small defects directly.
Plan executor. Merge and integrate the team's work, resolve conflicts, serve the final app on port 3000 bound to 0.0.0.0, publish with `tenki-publish 3000`, and print the URL.
Lighter coding tasks. Pick up small tasks, write the README, and keep the repo tidy.
